verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's own homepage invites users to "Register your entity or get a Unique Entity ID," which is the core transaction. The site also references a signed-in workspace (account details, System Accounts widget), so registration is implied to happen online. The evidence is a single homepage call-to-action and does not show the registration flow being completed online end to end. Missing for 10: first-party pages describing the online entity-registration steps and submission, and confirmation that registration can be completed fully online without offline steps.
